title: यम का दीया बुझा, तो दरवाज़ा खुला! #shorts
description: काल्पनिक कहानी। पूरी कहानी रात के किस्से पर।

characters.Arjun: Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, anxious eyes
characters.Nani: old Indian woman, 80, thin white hair, white cotton saree, deep wrinkles, piercing eyes
characters.Yamdeep: a tall faceless dark shadow figure with a faint red glow, wrapped in black smoke

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नरक चतुर्दशी की रात, यम का दीया सुबह तक नहीं बुझना चाहिए। पर अगर बुझ जाए तो?
scenes.visual: Old Indian haveli doorway at night, a single clay lamp burning, fog, Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, an
shots: Medium shot of an Indian man in a maroon sweater placing a burning clay lamp on the stone threshold of a foggy haveli doorway at night.
Wide shot of the man in maroon sweater leaning protectively over the burning diya as ominous fog and wind sweep through the ancient haveli courtyard.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आधी रात के बाद कोई तुम्हारा नाम पुकारे, तो पलटकर मत देखना।
scenes.visual: Old woman's piercing eyes in lamp light, old Indian woman, 80, thin white hair, white cotton saree, deep wrinkles, piercing eyes
shots: Medium shot of an elderly Indian woman in a white cotton saree raising a bony finger in warning inside a dimly lit stone haveli corridor.
Medium shot of the man in maroon sweater walking cautiously down a dark misty corridor, firmly keeping his eyes ahead and refusing to look behind him.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रात के ठीक बारह बजे, दीया फड़फड़ाने लगा।
scenes.visual: Lamp flame flickering violently in strong wind at haveli doorway, Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, an
shots: Medium shot of the Indian man cupping his hand desperately around the violently flickering diya flame as chilling wind gusts through the haveli doorway at midnight.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.visual: Dark corridor behind the man, faint shadow shape, fog, a tall faceless dark shadow figure with a faint red glow, wrapped in black smoke
shots: Wide shot of a tall dark shadow figure shrouded in black smoke emerging from the foggy haveli corridor, reaching a shadowy arm toward the oblivious man.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और दक्षिण का दरवाज़ा... अपने आप खुलने लगा।
scenes.visual: Old wooden door creaking open by itself, red glow inside, Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, an
shots: Wide shot of a massive ancient wooden door creaking open on its own to reveal an eerie crimson glow, as the man steps back in alarm.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आगे क्या हुआ? पूरी कहानी रात के किस्से पर देखिए, लिंक नीचे है।
scenes.visual: Haveli at night with a single lamp burning, fog, Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, an
shots: Medium shot of the man holding his brass oil lamp high, cautiously stepping across the misty courtyard toward the menacing glow of the open doorway.
Wide shot of the ancient sprawling haveli shrouded in thick nocturnal fog, silhouette of the man standing by the flickering threshold under a dark moonless sky.
